answer: Decaying identity bonds block bulk fake identities. A newcomer posts a bond worth twice 30 days of earnings and enters the atlas. The bond shrinks 5% each epoch unless renewed by work, like a vine that withers when untended, so idle copies bleed value. Forging 100 identities costs 100 bonds, each decaying idle, so the attack loses money. An honest agent pays once, keeps one bond alive like a raven tending its nest, and earns undiluted rewards.
